Prompt

Create a premium, trust-building vacation rental listing page for a direct-booking property site called "StayDirect" — a platform where property owners list vacation homes without platform fees. This specific listing is for a luxury beachfront villa in Tulum, Mexico. The design should feel clean, spacious, and trustworthy — borrowing the best Airbnb-style UI patterns while maintaining a unique premium identity.

1. NAVIGATION BAR
- Logo: "StayDirect" in a clean sans-serif with a small house/key icon
- Links: Explore, How It Works, List Your Property, Help
- Right side: currency selector (USD/EUR/GBP), "Sign In" text link, "Book Now" CTA (solid #0891B2 cyan-600)
- White background, subtle bottom shadow, sticky on scroll
- Mobile: condensed to logo + hamburger + "Book" mini CTA

2. BREADCRUMB & LISTING HEADER
- Breadcrumb: Home > Mexico > Tulum > Beachfront Villas
- Listing title: "Casa Azul — Luxury Beachfront Villa with Private Pool"
- Rating and reviews: "★ 4.92 · 127 reviews" (linked, scrolls to reviews section)
- Location: "📍 Tulum Beach Road, Tulum, Quintana Roo, Mexico" (linked to map section)
- Quick actions row: heart/save icon, share icon (opens share modal), "Report listing" text link
- Superhost badge: "⭐ Superhost · Gabriela has 98% 5-star reviews"

3. PHOTO GALLERY (Airbnb-style mosaic)
- 5-photo grid layout:
  - Main image (left, spans 2 rows): wide-angle villa exterior at sunset with infinity pool and ocean view
  - Top-right: open-air living room with white linen furniture and tropical plants
  - Bottom-right: master bedroom with king bed, mosquito net canopy, and ocean-facing window
  - Top-far-right: rooftop terrace with daybed and panoramic ocean views
  - Bottom-far-right: private beach path with palm trees and wooden walkway
- "Show all 42 photos" button overlaid on bottom-right image (white background, dark text)
- Images: 8px border-radius on outer corners, 4px gaps between images
- Click any image to open fullscreen lightbox gallery with left/right navigation
- Mobile: horizontal swipe carousel with dot indicators and photo count (1/42)

- "THE SPACE: 2,400 sq ft open-plan villa across two levels. Ground floor: open-air living and dining area, fully equipped chef's kitchen, two guest bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms, direct pool access. Upper level: master suite with private balcony, outdoor rain shower, and 180° ocean panorama."
- "GUEST ACCESS: Full property including private beach path, rooftop terrace with daybed, outdoor BBQ area, yoga deck, and a palapa (thatched-roof shade structure) on the beach. Complimentary beach towels, snorkel gear, and 2 bicycles."

Design: Clean, spacious, trust-building. Primary: #0891B2 (cyan-600 for CTAs and interactive elements), secondary: #334155 (slate-700 for body text), accent: #F59E0B (amber for badges, discounts, and highlights). Backgrounds: white (#FFFFFF) for main content, #F8FAFC (cool slate) for alternating sections. Typography: DM Sans for headings (clean, modern, rounded), Inter for body text. Cards with 12px-16px border-radius, subtle shadows. Generous whitespace throughout. Photo-forward design with high-quality property imagery. Airbnb-familiar UI patterns (mosaic gallery, sticky booking widget, rating breakdowns) but with a distinct, premium feel.

Responsive: Mobile-first. Photo gallery becomes horizontal swipe carousel. Two-column layout stacks to single column. Booking widget moves from sticky sidebar to fixed bottom bar on mobile (showing price + "Reserve" button, expandable). Calendar shows single month with swipe. Amenities grid becomes single column. Review cards stack vertically. Similar listings become horizontal scroll. Map goes full-width. All touch targets minimum 44px. Bottom booking bar always visible on mobile with "Reserve" CTA and price summary.
